children: posted a short-term gain of more than 20%.
BlockBeats reported that Super Inu surged more than 22% at one point on Oct. 4. The rally briefly lifted its market capitalization above $45 million.

The jump followed comments from Tesla Chief Executive Officer Elon Musk. In a social media post that day, Musk said he would no longer use the term artificial intelligence, or AI, adding that SI, short for Super Intelligence, was a better expression.
The U.S. government had also recently announced a policy to use the term SI instead of AI in official documents and other materials.
Super Inu, however, has no confirmed official link to Musk or related companies. The similarity between SI and the token’s ticker appears to have briefly spurred speculative demand.

title: Solana Meme Coin Super Inu Jumps, Tops $45 Million Market Cap on Musk’s ‘SI’ Remark
